_about: OOPS!-style ontology pitfall scan. Read-only; the graph is never written. Several findings are recorded design decisions rather than defects — the site panel says which, and the reasons are kept there, not here.

critical.message: 1156/1679 relation strings (69%) are used exactly once. The relation set is an open vocabulary.

critical.tag: P24 relation name encodes a proposition
critical.message: 270 relation strings are sentence-shaped: the predicate carries content that belongs in the object or a qualifier, so it cannot be queried as written.
12 distinct relation strings express the same semantics across 165 edges, with no equivalence declared. A query on any one misses the rest.
13 distinct relation strings express the same semantics across 507 edges, with no equivalence declared. A query on any one misses the rest.
10 distinct relation strings express the same semantics across 295 edges, with no equivalence declared. A query on any one misses the rest.
10 distinct relation strings express the same semantics across 142 edges, with no equivalence declared. A query on any one misses the rest.
15 distinct relation strings express the same semantics across 159 edges, with no equivalence declared. A query on any one misses the rest.
8 distinct relation strings express the same semantics across 45 edges, with no equivalence declared. A query on any one misses the rest.

Only 99/5132 edges (1.9%) are taxonomic and only 81/1244 nodes (7%) have any parent. There is no subsumption hierarchy to inherit or reason over. The graph is an associative network with a 6-way type tag.

important.tag: P05/P13 inverse relations declared but not linked
important.message: 9 inverse pairs coexist in the vocabulary (symbolizes/symbolized-by, amplified-by/amplifies, precedes/followed-by, contains/belongs-to, produces/produced-by, mother-of/child-of, father-of/child-of, is-goal-of/aims-at, exemplified-by/exemplifies). Nothing declares them inverse, so direction is a modelling choice made per-edge; 3 pairs are asserted in both directions and would be duplicates under a reasoner.

important.tag: P25 symmetric relation asserted one-way only
important.message: 415 edges use a symmetric relation but only assert one direction. Without a symmetry axiom, `A synonym-of B` does not answer a query for B's synonyms.

important.tag: P30 identity clusters not collapsed / no transitivity
important.message: 3 clusters of 3+ nodes are chained by identity-type relations without a transitivity axiom or a canonical representative. These are candidate duplicate entities.
7 components detached from the main graph.

important.tag: P24 node label is a definition, not a term
important.message: 42 nodes carry a full descriptive sentence as their label. These are assertions modelled as entities, so they cannot be reused or matched across edges.

important.tag: P11/P12 no domain or range declared
important.message: No relation has a declared domain/range. Observed signatures are unconstrained: `corresponds-to` spans 29 distinct (subject-type, object-type) pairs across 178 edges. Nothing can detect a mis-typed edge.
`is` is used 106 times, conflating subsumption, identity and predication. Cannot be interpreted without reading the quote.

minor.message: `Concept` holds 500/1244 nodes (40%) with no subdivision. The type system carries little discriminating power.

The 6 node types are never declared disjoint, and nothing forbids a node from being conceptually two at once (e.g. Mercurius is modelled Figure but functions as Substance and Symbol across its 52 edges). Type is a single free-text field.

_examples_dropped: the scan prints examples; their order is not stable between runs, so they are not carried into this file
